newsitem.title: SPAIN: Basque separatists bomb Spanish bank.
newsitem.headline: Basque separatists bomb Spanish bank.

text.p: A small bomb planted by Basque separatists exploded in a bank in Vitoria, northern Spain in the early hours of Saturday, police said.
The bomb, which caused slight damage to the building and nearby cars, was preceded by a warning call to the emergency services by the Basque separatist group ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom).
ETA has killed some 800 people since 1968 in its drive for an indepedent Basque state.
